opsGrowth.intro: Sign-ups, activation, retention, plan mix and connectors across all organisations — counts and rates from the platform's own tables, never event payloads or end-user data. All calendar values are UTC.

sample.title: Small numbers
sample.text: Fewer than {min} organisations exist. Rates are shown for completeness, but a single organisation moves them by whole percentage points — read the counts, not the percentages.

organizations.label: Organisations
organizations.hint: {count, plural, one {# new in the last 30 days} other {# new in the last 30 days}}

active.label: Active organisations · 7 d / 30 d
active.hint: {share7} / {share30} of all organisations, with accepted events

signups.title: Sign-ups
signups.intro: New accounts and organisations by creation date. An account that creates an organisation counts in both series; invited members count as accounts only.

chart.daily: Grouped bars per day: organisations and accounts created. The table below the chart lists the same values.
chart.weekly: Grouped bars per ISO week starting Monday: organisations and accounts created. The table below the chart lists the same values.

empty.title: No sign-ups in this window
empty.text: No account or organisation was created in the last 12 weeks.

funnel.title: Activation funnel
funnel.intro: Milestones every organisation can reach, measured from the tables that record them. Milestones are independent: an organisation counts at a stage once it reached that milestone, whether or not it passed the earlier ones.
funnel.caption: Activation stages with organisation counts, conversion rates and median time from sign-up
funnel.note: Rates are ratios of counts. "Of previous stage" can exceed 100 % because milestones are independent — an organisation can pay without a verified domain.

empty.title: No organisations yet
empty.text: The funnel fills once the first organisation is created.

retention.title: Weekly retention
retention.intro: Organisations by sign-up week (Monday, UTC) and the share still sending accepted events in each week after sign-up — week 0 is the first seven days. Measured from the hourly event aggregates.
retention.caption: Weekly retention cohorts: share of each sign-up week active in the weeks after sign-up

legend.scale: Darker cells mean a larger share of the cohort was active; every cell also shows its percentage.
legend.partial: Dashed cells are still running — the week has not ended for every organisation of the cohort.
legend.small: Cohorts with fewer than {min} organisations are marked; one organisation moves their rate by a large step.

retention.horizonNone: No hourly aggregates on record yet — activity cannot be measured.

empty.title: No sign-ups in the last {weeks} weeks
empty.text: Cohorts appear once an organisation is created inside the window.

planMix.title: Plan mix
planMix.intro: Organisations by catalogue plan and subscription state from the billing ledger. Organisations without a ledger row never started a checkout.
planMix.caption: Organisations per plan and subscription state

empty.title: No organisations yet
empty.text: The plan mix fills once the first organisation exists.

connectors.title: Connectors in use
connectors.intro: Connector types ranked by the organisations that have at least one connected destination of that type. Counts of integrations only — no identifiers, no credentials.
connectors.caption: Connector types by organisations using them
connectors.more: {count, plural, one {# more connector type with fewer organisations is not listed.} other {# more connector types with fewer organisations are not listed.}}

empty.title: No destinations yet
empty.text: Connectors appear here once an organisation adds a destination.

items.sources: Sign-ups count rows of the account and organisation tables by creation date; nothing is sampled or estimated.
items.milestones: Funnel milestones: first site row; first verified domain (domains.verified_at); first hourly aggregate with accepted events; creation date of a currently connected destination (a destination that was disconnected again does not count); first configuration publication; creation of an active subscription in the billing ledger.
items.proxies: The destination and paying instants are proxies — the connection and the checkout themselves carry no timestamp — so their median times are approximate.
items.retention: Retention and activity rest on the hourly event aggregates; if aggregates were pruned by retention policies, older cohorts look inactive. The aggregate horizon is shown below the grid.
items.noGeo: No geographic split: Track stores no country for accounts or organisations, so none is shown.
items.privacy: Everything on this page is a count or a rate over all organisations. No organisation, account, visitor or event is identified.
